target_zoom.why: Day 7: low-row station fills the 720p width already (x 151-1029 at 1.5x); keep <=1.5x upscale (sharp), scale 0.95, lift so the stack box is not cut at the bottom, centre figure+machine bbox

front.camera_note: side camera along the fixed machine (D7_MACHINE_CONCEPT), whole-frame mirror so the tower is on the right

mistake_type_why: t612u: muscle-fibre 2-step like Day 6. Mistake = pulling with the arms and shrugging (load on biceps/upper traps) vs chest up, scapulae down/back, elbows driven back (lats). Not the joint-type lumbar rounding / lean-back rock (that would need the 4-step bone format).
camera_plan_note: 2-step: both steps from the same elevated front-3/4 camera on a low-row station (stack box at lower right), identical machine (right frame made from the wrong frame).
callouts_note: t557u: callouts are derived per motion (motions.*.callout) - steps 1/3 and 2/4 share angle + label

callout_axis.why: t567u: callout axis follows the upper arm (shoulder -> elbow), short torso reference

source_clips_note: t660u v3: output/assets/day7_{wrong,right}_raw_v3.mp4 from pinned stills output/_consistency/d7m/pin_*_720x1280.png (already cropped to the final framing; frame_override 1:1).
native_why: t600: fix plan of docs/ROOTCAUSE_DAY6.md - clip's own pixels, temporal flow denoise, flat-field backdrop gain, one tone curve per step, linear glow, flow-locked callout joints, no slice cap, continuous motion phase at the cut, hips/ankles alignment; static_body_shin_r capsule and metal re-shade not used
callout_note: deg = ELBOW FLEXION (180 - shoulder-elbow-wrist) of the visible arm, MEASURED by layout.measure_angle from the pipeline keypoints at the last frame of each slice (t652u: no faked numbers): wrong 78, right 75. Inside the seated_cable_row band; the difference (shrug vs elbows past the torso) is carried by the labels. (was a fixed 105.)
native_skin_p90_why: Day 4 lock p90 (spec skin_lock_all_steps 88); 84 (Day 6 v5) left Day 7 p90 at 79-83 under the (f) band 81-95
native_muscle_shader_why: t648u: muscle fibre/colour/glow = Day 4 muscle.day4_fibre (unchanged) on the source's native glow (act_dom, _glow_gain calibrated); muscle_glow_clamp = allowed anatomy regions (gymform/region_glow.py) multiplied into act_dom so colour cannot spill. Both opt-in, default off: Day 4/5/6 configs unchanged.
simplify_why: t652u-t653u: no laser/leader/dot, no sub-label; big MEASURED angle (shoulder angle trunk->upper arm of the visible arm, at the slice's last = peak frame) + one short label; one fixed crop/scale for stills and clips (frame_override) so mannequin + machine fill 9:16
day4_calibration_why: t654u: measured at equal torso scale vs the Day 4 master (tools/day4_look_metrics.py, sweeps A-J in output/_consistency/d7m/sweep_*): glow-pixel V median wrong 155 vs D4 157, right 194 vs D4 190; hue/sat/fibre contrast within ~10%. Set for the locked stills (wrong t1, right t2); re-measure on the i2v clips (their glow level differs).
frame_override_why: t660u: the pinned stills (and so the i2v clips) are already cropped to the t652u final framing (old frame_override scale 1.53/dx 62/dy 247 on the 1024 composite = window x 215.7-885.1, y -236.2-953.1), so the clip maps 1:1 onto 1080x1920; machine pixels unchanged (crop + resize only)
